title: 第3章 世间总不缺找抽的人第4章 可进化僵尸
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
正是因为这个如机械一般没有感情的声音，让叶凌出神了好一会儿。
蓦然回过神，叶凌脸色抑制不住的狂喜。
“叶凌！”
一直在旁边的陈志，使劲的摇晃了一下叶凌。
回过神来的叶凌，顿时心中一惊，连忙收敛起了自己的喜悦。
这才回过头，看向了陈志，疑惑道。
“陈志，你刚刚说什么？抱歉，刚才有点出神了。”
听到这话，陈志露出一脸无语的表情。
合着自己刚才说了啥，叶凌这家伙啥都没有听到。
“我说……唉！
算了，没什么，趁着这几天，你好好加油努力吧，看看能不能够争取考上一个低级御灵使学院。”
说着，陈志深深的叹了一口气。
他也知道，叶凌获得的灵宠是一个僵尸，行动速度极慢，并且还不能进化的僵尸。
刚才叶凌出神，陈志以为这件事情，给叶凌造成了巨大的打击，还没有让他缓过来，才时不时的出神。
“加油吧！”
再次用力的拍了拍叶凌的肩膀，陈志鼓励道。
闻言，叶凌点了点头，没有多说什么。
现在，他更在意的是自己的系统。
只不过现在在这种公众的场合，也不知道打开系统会不会造成什么异象，叶凌决定还是尽早回家再说。
“放心好了，我的目标可不是低级御灵使学院。”

现在已经有了系统的叶凌，虽然还不知道系统到底有什么用处，但是仅仅只是一个低级御灵使学院，怎么可能满足得了叶凌。
而陈志微微有些错愕，不过也没有太在意，只当是叶凌有着足够的自信，这个是件好事。
当然，叶凌的话，他也不会太过当真。
以叶凌手上的那只僵尸灵宠，能不能够考进低级御灵使学院，都是一个极大的问题。
“哈哈哈哈！
你们刚刚听到叶凌说什么？他的目标不是低级御灵使学院？哈哈哈哈！”
这时，一旁传来了极其嚣张的大笑声。
这大笑声和略微有些刺耳的话，让叶凌和陈志都不禁皱了皱眉。
扭头看去，一个衣着光鲜，看上去就知道家里面肯定有点实力的男生，满脸嚣张的样子。
对于这个人，叶凌倒是一点都不陌生。
content_en:
It was precisely because of this mechanical and emotionless voice that made Ye Ling trance for a while.
Suddenly coming back to his senses, Ye Ling's face could not suppress the ecstasy.
"Ye Ling!"
Chen Zhi, who had been beside him, shook Ye Ling vigorously.
When Ye Ling came back to his senses, he was suddenly shocked and quickly restrained his joy.
Then he turned around and looked at Chen Zhi, wondering.
"Chen Zhi, what did you just say? Sorry, I was a little lost just now."
Hearing this, Chen Zhi showed a speechless expression.
Regardless of what he just said, Ye Ling didn't hear anything.
"I said... alas!
Forget it, it's nothing. Take advantage of these few days to work hard and see if you can get into a low-level spirit master academy. "
As he spoke, Chen Zhi sighed deeply.
He also knew that the spiritual pet Ye Ling obtained was a zombie, a zombie that moved extremely slowly and could not evolve.
Ye Ling was in a trance just now. Chen Zhi thought that this incident had dealt a huge blow to Ye Ling and had not yet allowed him to recover, so he was in trance from time to time.
"Come on!"
Chen Zhi patted Ye Ling's shoulder hard again and encouraged him.
Hearing this, Ye Ling nodded and said nothing more.
Now, he is more concerned about his system.
But now in such a public place, he didn't know if turning on the system would cause any strange phenomena, so Ye Ling decided to go home as soon as possible.
"Don't worry, my goal is not the low-level Spirit Control Academy."
Now that Ye Ling has the system, although he still doesn't know what the system is used for, how can it be possible for it to be satisfied with just a low-level Spirit Control Academy?
Chen Zhi was slightly surprised, but he didn't pay too much attention. He just thought it was a good thing that Ye Ling had enough confidence.
Of course, he would not take Ye Ling's words too seriously.
With the zombie spirit pet in Ye Ling's hand, whether he can be admitted to the low-level spirit master academy is a huge question.
“Hahahaha!
What did you just hear Ye Ling say? Isn't his target the low-level Spirit Control Academy? Hahahaha! "
At this time, extremely arrogant laughter came from the side.
The loud laughter and slightly harsh words made both Ye Ling and Chen Zhi frown.
Turning around, he saw a well-dressed boy who looked like he must have some strength in his family, with an arrogant look on his face.
Ye Ling was not unfamiliar with this person at all.
